compiledWorldPlacement.buildingProxyScope: actual current place-group mesh AABBs only; not full building geometry or transparent original-art fixture volume clearance

meadowInstances.scope: every actual current meadow instance geometry AABB transformed by its actual instance and world matrix, expanded .018 in all axes; current finite matrices and authored animation allowance, no all-frame proof

shoreline.method: every actual dry-land boundary segment against entire trolley XZ AABB

compiledWorldPlacement.limits: one fixed authored standalone trolley pose at one synthetic current-default-world site;20 finite sole/floor ray pairs on four fixed wheel bottom chord faces,63 finite walkability samples and conservative current road, original-card, meadow, shore and building-proxy envelope clearances. These finite witnesses do not verify full wheel-face contact, support stability, load, physical behavior, body fit, whole-world placement or all-camera visibility

compiledWorldScope: Existing current Scene after synchronous construction/tree-road correction. Node has no DOM or original-art decode; native originalArt-ready Scene and visual checks remain separate.
